name: Westfield Promenade
description: Westfield Promenade is a premier regional shopping destination in the heart of Woodland Hills, featuring a diverse mix of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment venues. Managed by Westfield, this open-air center offers a modern shopping experience with convenient access to Topanga Canyon Boulevard. The center serves the affluent San Fernando Valley community with upscale retailers and popular national brands.
summary: A modern Westfield-managed regional shopping center offering diverse retail, dining, and entertainment in Woodland Hills.
